caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden armchair placed against a plain, off-white background with no additional objects or scenery visible. The chair is constructed from several planks and branches of wood, with a backrest made up of three vertical, roughly cut wooden slats, the central slat of which has a diamond-shaped cutout near the top. The seat consists of two large, rectangular wooden panels. The arms of the chair are flat and thick, extending from the backrest supports to the front legs. The legs and supporting structure include four thick, rounded wooden posts joined by horizontal wooden rails near the base. The wood is colored in shades of brown with some greenish and reddish undertones, and the texture of the wood grain is visible throughout the chair's surface. The artist’s signature “CLAFLIN TAOS” is written in small letters at the lower right corner of the image.
title: Chair
